title: Friday, 9:32 AM
summary: On Friday morning, February 6, 2015, Jordan suffers an acute heart attack during ENGL 102 in Walton Hall and is rushed to New River Valley Medical Center. After visits from Hall Director Kelsey Brennan and RAs Isabel Dawson and Garrett Reynolds, a balloon angioplasty fails against a rock-hard calcified blockage—requiring a transfer to Star City General Hospital in Roanoke for open-heart CABG surgery and beginning a grueling weekend NPO watch.
